name: Disable Network Adapter Power Saving
description: Prevents Windows from powering down physical network adapters during use to maintain consistent connectivity.

description_i18n.en: Prevents Windows from powering down physical network adapters during use to maintain consistent connectivity.
description_i18n.de: Verhindert, dass Windows physische Netzwerkadapter während der Nutzung abschaltet, um eine konsistente Verbindung zu gewährleisten.
description_i18n.fr: Empêche Windows de mettre hors tension les cartes réseau physiques pendant l'utilisation pour maintenir une connectivité constante.

warnings.title: Power usage increase
warnings.message: Disabling adapter power saving may slightly increase power consumption, battery drain, or heat on laptops

warnings.title: Registry change
warnings.message: Persistent Windows settings may change until the tweak is restored

compatibility.notes: Applies to physical network adapters with standard Windows power-management registry entries.

technical_details: Modifies the PnPCapabilities registry value on physical network adapter class keys and invokes NetAdapter power-management cmdlets to disable automatic sleep states
